image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in a snowy landscape with sparse, leafless shrubs in the foreground. The bird displays characteristic bluish-black plumage with iridescent sheen, prominent red eyebrow combs, and white undertail coverts. Its tail feathers are fanned out in a lyre shape.
